sentences.en: - Good morning. (audience cheers) (laughs) To the class of 2018, the faculty, the parents, the grandparents, fellow honorees, and the paid laughers I have scattered throughout the audience,
sentences.zh: - 早上好。 （观众欢呼）（笑）致2018届的同学们，老师们，家长们，祖父母们，获奖者们，以及我散布在观众席上的那些付费笑声，

sentences.en: (audience laughs) it is an honor to join you this morning for this special occasion.
sentences.zh: （观众笑）很荣幸今天早上能和大家一起参加这个特殊的场合。

sentences.en: It is also an honor to speak to you today from behind this gigantic tree stump.
sentences.zh: 今天我也很荣幸能在这个巨大的树桩后面与您交谈。

sentences.en: (audience laughs) Like some sort of female Lorax with an advanced degree.
sentences.zh: （观众笑）就像某种拥有高等学位的女性洛拉克斯。

sentences.en: That's right, you guys, I'm hitting Dr. Seuss hard and early in this speech.
sentences.zh: 是的，你们，我在这次演讲的一开始就严厉批评了苏斯博士。

sentences.en: Because Dartmouth grads have a privilege unique among all the Ivy League, we will be forced to be mini experts on Dr. Seuss for our entire lives.
sentences.zh: 因为达特茅斯的毕业生在所有常春藤联盟中享有独特的特权，所以我们将被迫一生成为苏斯博士的迷你专家。

sentences.en: On my deathbed, I'll be saying "Did you know "that his real name was Theodor Geisel?
sentences.zh: 在我临终之际，我会说“你知道吗”他的真名是西奥多·盖泽尔？

sentences.en: "Did you know that he was the editor "of the Dartmouth Jack-O-Lantern?"
sentences.zh: “你知道他是‘达特茅斯南瓜灯’的编辑吗？”

sentences.en: And yes, while no US presidents have gone to Dartmouth, we can at least lay claim to the wonderful Dr. Seuss.
sentences.zh: 是的，虽然没有美国总统去过达特茅斯，但我们至少可以承认伟大的苏斯博士。

sentences.en: Another notable alumnus is Salmon P. Chase, the man on the $10,000 bill, a symbolically powerful piece of paper that's largely useless in the real world.
sentences.zh: 另一位著名的校友是萨蒙·P·蔡斯 (Salmon P. Chase)，他是 10,000 美元纸币上的人物，这张纸币具有强大的象征意义，但在现实世界中基本上毫无用处。

sentences.en: Like a degree in playwriting, which I received from this very institution.
sentences.zh: 就像我从这所机构获得的剧本创作学位一样。

sentences.en: (audience laughs) Thank you for paying for that, Mom and Dad.
sentences.zh: （观众笑）谢谢你们为此付出的代价，爸爸妈妈。

sentences.en: It's a thrill to be back here in New Hampshire, the Granite State, known for two things.
sentences.zh: 回到以两件事而闻名的花岗岩之州新罕布什尔州，我感到很兴奋。

sentences.en: The place where you can legally not wear your seatbelt and Adam Sandler's birthplace.
sentences.zh: 在这里，你可以合法地不系安全带，也是亚当·桑德勒的出生地。

sentences.en: New Hampshire has one of the best mottos of any state.
sentences.zh: 新罕布什尔州拥有所有州中最好的座右铭之一。

sentences.en: Live free or die. For outsiders, it sounds like an exciting declaration of freedom, but when you're here in January, die actually sounds like a pretty good option.
sentences.zh: 要么自由地生活，要么死去。对于外人来说，这听起来像是令人兴奋的自由宣言，但当你在一月份来到这里时，死亡实际上听起来是一个不错的选择。

sentences.en: (audience laughs) I remember the days when it was so cold, your sneeze would become an ice sculpture before it hit the ground.
sentences.zh: （众笑）我记得那时候天很冷，你的喷嚏还没落地就变成了冰雕。

sentences.en: (audience laughs) In Los Angeles, where I live now, if I sneeze, I just call my doctor and have my blood replaced with that of a teenage track star.
sentences.zh: （观众笑）在我现在居住的洛杉矶，如果我打喷嚏，我就会打电话给我的医生，然后用青少年田径明星的血液替换我的血液。

sentences.en: (audience laughs) That's normal there. I'm mostly track star right now.
sentences.zh: （观众笑）这在那里很正常。我现在主要是田径明星。

sentences.en: Before I get any further, I should actually probably clarify who I am for the parents and grandparents in the audience who are thinking to themselves "Who is this loud Indian woman?
sentences.zh: 在我进一步讨论之前，我实际上应该向观众中的父母和祖父母澄清我是谁，他们正在思考“这个大声的印度女人是谁？

sentences.en: "Is that the girl from Quantico? "She looks so much worse in person."
sentences.zh: “那是匡蒂科的那个女孩吗？”“她本人看上去差多了。”

sentences.en: (audience laughs) No, no, I'm not Priyanka Chopra.
sentences.zh: （观众笑）不，不，我不是朴雅卡·乔普拉。

sentences.en: Not even Padma Lakshmi. I'm the other Indian woman we have allowed to be on television, Mindy Kaling.
sentences.zh: 甚至连帕德玛·拉克希米也不行。我是我们允许上电视的另一位印度女性，Mindy Kaling。

sentences.en: (audience applauds) Thank you, thank you.
sentences.zh: （观众鼓掌）谢谢，谢谢。

sentences.en: You may remember me from my role on The Office as Kelly Kapoor, who internet commenters said was, quote, "shrill."
sentences.zh: 你可能还记得我在《办公室》中饰演的凯莉·卡普尔（Kelly Kapoor），互联网评论者称她“尖刻”。

sentences.en: (audience laughs) And, quote, "Took up valuable time that could have gone "to Steve Carell."
sentences.zh: （观众笑）并且，引用，“占用了本来可以花在‘史蒂夫·卡瑞尔’身上的宝贵时间。”

sentences.en: I then created and starred in my own TV show, The Mindy Project.
sentences.zh: 然后我创作并主演了我自己的电视节目《明迪计划》。

sentences.en: (audience applauds) Thank you, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: （观众鼓掌）谢谢，非常感谢。

sentences.en: It was an uphill battle to get that show on the air but it was worth it, because it enabled me to become Dartmouth's most successful female minority show creator who has spoken at commencement.
sentences.zh: 播出该节目是一场艰苦的战斗，但这是值得的，因为它使我成为达特茅斯最成功的少数族裔女性节目创作者，并在毕业典礼上发表了讲话。

sentences.en: (audience laughs) Oh wait, no. Shonda Rhimes went here.
sentences.zh: （观众笑）哦等等，不。珊达·莱姆斯去了这里。

sentences.en: (audience laughs) Yep, and she's created like 10 more shows than me, so great, no, cool.
sentences.zh: （观众笑）是的，她比我多创作了 10 个节目，太棒了，不，很酷。

sentences.en: Cool, cool, Shonda, friggin' role model, good for you.
sentences.zh: 酷，酷，珊达，该死的榜样，对你有好处。

sentences.en: (audience laughs) But today is not about famous alumni.
sentences.zh: （观众笑）但是今天不是关于著名校友的。

sentences.en: No, no. It is about the men and women who have toiled in obscurity for years so that they might better our country.
sentences.zh: 不，不。这是关于那些默默无闻地辛勤工作多年、以便让我们的国家变得更好的男男女女的故事。

sentences.en: I speak, of course, of the 51% of Dartmouth grads who will go into finance.
sentences.zh: 当然，我指的是 51% 的达特茅斯毕业生将进入金融行业。

sentences.en: (audience laughs) Highest in the Ivy League.
sentences.zh: （观众笑）常春藤联盟中最高的。

sentences.en: Look left, look right. All three of you will be spending at least 10 years in a white collar prison.
sentences.zh: 向左看，向右看。你们三个将在白领监狱里度过至少 10 年。

sentences.en: (audience laughs) I know that going into the real world sounds scary but it's exciting too.
sentences.zh: （观众笑）我知道进入现实世界听起来很可怕，但也很令人兴奋。

sentences.en: Finally, you'll be in control of your own lives.
sentences.zh: 最后，你将掌控自己的生活。

sentences.en: No longer will there be an irrational board of trustees telling you can't have hard liquor on campus.
sentences.zh: 不再会有非理性的董事会告诉你不能在校园里喝烈性酒。

sentences.en: (audience laughs) Thank you. For the ridiculous reason that they don't want you to die.
sentences.zh: （观众笑）谢谢。出于可笑的原因，他们不想让你死。

sentences.en: Come tomorrow, no one can stop you from filling your apartment with 4.99 handles of Uncle Satan's Unfiltered Potato Vodka.
sentences.zh: 明天吧，没有人能阻止你在你的公寓里装满 4.99 手柄撒旦叔叔的未过滤土豆伏特加。

sentences.en: Go crazy. It's a real moment of reflection for me to be standing here speaking to all of you now because it makes me hearken back to my own time at my Dartmouth graduation.
sentences.zh: 发疯吧。现在站在这里对你们所有人讲话对我来说是一个真正的反思时刻，因为这让我回想起自己在达特茅斯毕业典礼上的时光。

sentences.en: Madeleine Albright was my commencement speaker.
sentences.zh: 马德琳·奥尔布赖特是我的毕业典礼演讲者。

sentences.en: And while I don't remember any specific quotes she said or even a general gist of what she was talking about, (audience laughs) I do remember thinking "I wonder what it'll be like "to have my own cell phone."
sentences.zh: 虽然我不记得她说过什么具体的话，甚至不记得她所说的大体要点，（观众笑）我确实记得我在想“我想知道“拥有自己的手机”会是什么样子。

sentences.en: How things have changed. (audience laughs) For all I know, at this very moment, most of you are posting this speech on your Instagram stories with a GIF of Winnie the Pooh twerking.
sentences.zh: 事情发生了怎样的变化。 （观众笑）据我所知，此时此刻，你们中的大多数人都在 Instagram 故事上发布了这篇演讲，并附上了小熊维尼电臀舞的 GIF。

sentences.en: (audience laughs) If you are, please at least use my official hashtag, #MindyGoesBigGreen2018.
sentences.zh: （观众笑）如果是的话，请至少使用我的官方标签#MindyGoesBigGreen2018。

sentences.en: Thank you. (audience applauds) I bet none of you remember a time before the internet.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。 （观众鼓掌）我敢打赌你们都不记得互联网出现之前的时代。

sentences.en: Hell, you probably don't even remember a time before the Facebook page Dartmouth Memes for Cold AF Teens.
sentences.zh: 天哪，你可能根本不记得 Facebook 页面 Dartmouth Memes for Cold AF Teens 之前的情况。

sentences.en: (audience cheers) Yeah, yeah, I know about that.
sentences.zh: （观众欢呼）是的，是的，我知道这一点。

sentences.en: Made me feel like a real creep researching it.
sentences.zh: 让我觉得自己像 一个真正的爬行研究它。

sentences.en: Hello, I'm a 38 year old woman who wants to join your teen Facebook group.
sentences.zh: 你好,我是一个38岁的女人 谁想加入你的青少年脸书组。

sentences.en: It's for research, I swear. Meanwhile, while I was in college, we didn't even have Google.
sentences.zh: 我发誓,我上大学的时候 连谷歌都没有

sentences.en: You wanted to find out, say, how tall Ben Affleck was, you were out of luck.
sentences.zh: 你想弄清楚 Ben Affleck有多高 你运气不好

sentences.en: You just had to sit there not knowing and your entire day would be ruined.
sentences.zh: 你只是坐在那里不知道 和你的整个一天会毁了。

sentences.en: (audience laughs) Or say I wanted to meet up with a friend.
sentences.zh: 或者说我想见见一个朋友

sentences.en: I couldn't just text her, I had to walk outside and hope I accidentally bumped into her.
sentences.zh: 我不能只是发短信给她, 我不得不走出去 希望我偶然撞到她。

sentences.en: Or I Blitzed her. Ah, BlitzMail. You know that feeling you have when you tell your friends that you Blitz and they don't get it and roll your eyes all smug like "Oh, it's a Dartmouth thing."
sentences.zh: 或者我打中了她 闪电侠 你知道当你告诉你朋友你闪电侠

sentences.en: That ends today. (audience laughs) You try to say Blitz 100 yards east of White River Junction and you will get laughed back to your one room triple in the Choates.
sentences.zh: 白河交汇点以东100码处的Blitz 就会被嘲笑回到你Choates的3个房间

sentences.en: (audience laughs) Fun fact. In 2001, the year I graduated, a pink eye epidemic broke out amongst my classmates because we were all using public BlitzMail iMac terminals and not washing our hands.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是,在2001年,我毕业的那一年,我的同学们爆发了一场粉红眼炎, 因为我们都使用公共的BlitzMail iMac终端,而不是洗手。

sentences.en: Those are just kind of sexy stories indicative of my time at Dartmouth.
sentences.zh: 这些只是一些性感的故事 说明我在达特茅斯的时候

sentences.en: You have so many cool new things here now.
sentences.zh: 你这里有好多很酷的新东西

sentences.en: Like look at the new logo, the D-Pine. It's beautiful.
sentences.zh: 像看新的标志,D-Pine。

sentences.en: It reminds me of what college age Mindy thought a marijuana weed might look like but I was too scared to actually find out.
sentences.zh: 这让我想起了哪个大学时代的明迪 认为大麻可能长得像 但我太害怕了

sentences.en: (audience laughs) And this new house system, it sounds really cool.
sentences.zh: (观众笑) 和这个新的房子系统, 它听起来很酷。

sentences.en: It's so Hogwarts-y. You know, you sorted into your little Gryffindors and Ravenclaws, except they're called South House, West House, School House.
sentences.zh: 你知道,你整理了你的小格里芬多尔斯和拉文克拉斯 除了他们叫南屋、西屋、校舍

sentences.en: (audience laughs) Okay, come on, guys, School House, really?
sentences.zh: (观众笑) 好了,来吧,伙计们,学校之家,真的吗?

sentences.en: We're just saying what we see? That's the laziest name I've ever heard in my life and I spent over a decade working on shows called The Office and The Mindy Project.
sentences.zh: 我这辈子听过的最懒的名字 我花了十年时间在"办公室"和"明蒂项目"的节目上

sentences.en: (audience laughs) Still, I remember sitting where you're sitting.
sentences.zh: 我还记得你坐的地方

sentences.en: I was so full of questions like "When is thing gonna end?"
sentences.zh: 我问得太多了 比如"事情什么时候会结束?"

sentences.en: and "How many friends can I invite to dinner "and still have Mom and Dad pay?"
sentences.zh: "我还能邀请多少朋友来吃晚饭?" "还有爸妈付钱?"

sentences.en: And most importantly, "Why didn't I wear any clothes "underneath my gown?"
sentences.zh: 最重要的是, "我为什么不穿任何衣服" "下我的礼服?"

sentences.en: (audience laughs) Now we're reaching the part of the speech where I'm supposed to tell you something uplifting, like follow your dreams.
sentences.zh: (观众笑) 现在,我们到达部分 演讲,我应该 告诉你一些提升的东西, 就像跟随你的梦想。

sentences.en: In general, advice isn't actually an effective way to change your life.
sentences.zh: 一般来说,建议并不是改变你生活的有效方法。

sentences.en: If all it took to make your life great was hearing amazing advice, then everyone who watched TED Talks would be a millionaire.
sentences.zh: 如果为了让你的生活变得伟大 需要听到惊人的建议 那么所有观看TED演讲的人 都会成为百万富翁

sentences.en: So don't trust any one story of how to become successful.
sentences.zh: 因此，不要相信任何关于如何成功的故事。

sentences.en: As Madeleine Albright said at my commencement...
sentences.zh: 正如玛德琳·奥尔布赖特在我的毕业典礼上所说的那样……

sentences.en: See, I don't remember anything and I do just fine.
sentences.zh: 看，我什么都不记得了，但我做得很好。

sentences.en: So here is some practical advice. (audience laughs) That you may or may not remember at the end of the speech because, hey, that's the gig.
sentences.zh: 所以这里有一些实用的建议。 （观众笑）演讲结束时你可能记得也可能不记得，因为，嘿，这就是演出。

sentences.en: One. First off, remove "proficient at Word" from your resume.
sentences.zh: 一。首先，从你的简历中删除“精通Word”。

sentences.en: That is ridiculous. You're really scraping the bottom of the barrel of competency there.
sentences.zh: 这太荒谬了。你真的是在摸索能力的底部。

sentences.en: This is how you become proficient at Word.
sentences.zh: 这就是您精通 Word 的方法。

sentences.en: You open Word on your computer. (audience laughs) Two.
sentences.zh: 您在计算机上打开 Word。 （观众笑）两个。

sentences.en: Most of your post-college life is simply filling out forms.
sentences.zh: 大学毕业后的大部分生活只是填写表格。

sentences.en: Car insurance, health insurance, W2s, W4s, 1099s.
sentences.zh: 汽车保险、健康保险、W2、W4、1099。

sentences.en: Guess what? None of us know what any of those forms mean but you will fill out 100 of them before you die.
sentences.zh: 你猜怎么着？我们谁都不知道这些表格的含义，但在你去世之前你会填写其中的 100 张。

sentences.en: (audience laughs) Three. You never need more than one pancake.
sentences.zh: （观众笑）三。你永远不需要超过一张煎饼。

sentences.en: Trust me on this. Cartoons have trained us to want a giant stack of those bad boys, but order one first and then just see how you feel later.
sentences.zh: 相信我。卡通片让我们想要一大堆坏男孩，但先订购一个，然后看看你的感受如何。

sentences.en: (audience laughs) This one is just for guys.
sentences.zh: （观众笑）这个是男生专用的。

sentences.en: When you go on dates, act as if every woman you're talking to is a reporter for an online publication that you are scared of.
sentences.zh: 当你去约会时，表现得好像每一个与你交谈的女人都是你害怕的在线出版物的记者。

sentences.en: (audience laughs) One shouldn't need the threat of public exposure and scorn to treat women well, but if that's what it's gonna take, fine.
sentences.zh: （观众笑）人们不应该需要公开曝光和蔑视的威胁来善待女性，但如果这就是需要的，那好吧。

sentences.en: Date like everyone's watching, because we are.
sentences.zh: 像每个人都在观看一样约会，因为我们就是这样。

sentences.en: (audience laughs) Five, and this might be the most important.
sentences.zh: （众笑）五个，这个可能是最重要的。

sentences.en: Buy a toilet plunger. Trust me on this, don't wait until you need a plunger to buy a plunger.
sentences.zh: 买个马桶塞。相信我，不要等到需要柱塞时才购买柱塞。

sentences.en: (audience laughs) Commencement is a time of transition for parents too.
sentences.zh: （观众笑）开学对于父母来说也是一个过渡时期。

sentences.en: That empty nest you were enjoying these past four years?
sentences.zh: 过去四年你享受的那个空巢吗？

sentences.en: Gone as soon as the speech is over. I hope you like full time lodgers who don't pay rent, don't do laundry, eat all the food in your fridge, and binge Family Guy on your sofa for weeks.
sentences.zh: 演讲一结束就走了。我希望你喜欢全职房客，他们不付房租，不洗衣服，吃完冰箱里的所有食物，在沙发上狂看《恶搞之家》几个星期。

sentences.en: That is your life now. Although some of your graduates will be making more money than you.
sentences.zh: 这就是你现在的生活。尽管你的一些毕业生会比你赚更多的钱。

sentences.en: 51%, to be exact. (audience laughs) And to the parents of those investment bankers, consultants, and hedge fund analysts, congratulations.
sentences.zh: 确切地说，是51%。 （观众笑）祝贺那些投资银行家、顾问和对冲基金分析师的父母。

sentences.en: Your kids will be fabulously wealthy but still somehow sharing your cell phone plan because it, quote, "saves everybody money."
sentences.zh: 你的孩子会非常富有，但仍然会以某种方式分享你的手机套餐，因为它“为每个人省钱”。

sentences.en: Okay, now let's get real. Let me rip off the Band-Aid for all of you, the 18s.
sentences.zh: 好吧，现在让我们说实话。让我为你们这些18岁的人撕掉创可贴。

sentences.en: The next year of your life is going to be bad.
sentences.zh: 明年你的生活将会很糟糕。

sentences.en: You have been in the comfortable fleece-lined room of Mother Dartmouth for four years now and you're gonna go out in the cold, hard world.
sentences.zh: 你已经在达特茅斯修女舒适的羊毛衬里的房间里呆了四年了，你将要走出去，进入寒冷、艰苦的世界。

sentences.en: Out there in the real world, there will be a target on your back.
sentences.zh: 在现实世界中，你的背上会有一个目标。

sentences.en: People will want to confirm their expectations of Ivy League graduates, that you're a jerk, that you're spoiled, that you use the word summer as a verb.
sentences.zh: 人们会想确认他们对常春藤盟校毕业生的期望，你是个混蛋，你被宠坏了，你用夏天这个词作为动词。

sentences.en: (audience laughs) Though stereotypes exist for a reason.
sentences.zh: （观众笑）虽然刻板印象的存在是有原因的。

sentences.en: I mean, come on, the guy from the $10,000 bill went to this school.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，来吧，拿着 10,000 美元钞票的那个人去了这所学校。

sentences.en: You're graduating into a world where it seems like everything is falling apart.
sentences.zh: 你即将毕业，进入一个似乎一切都在崩溃的世界。

sentences.en: Trust in institutions are at a record low, the truth doesn't seem to matter anymore, and for all I know the President just tweeted us into a war with Wakanda, a country that doesn't exist.
sentences.zh: 对机构的信任处于历史最低水平，真相似乎不再重要，据我所知，总统刚刚在推特上发推文让我们与瓦坎达（一个不存在的国家）发生战争。

sentences.en: (audience laughs) So, class of 2018, you are entering a world that we have toppled like a Jenga tower and we are relying on you to rebuild it.
sentences.zh: （观众笑）所以，2018 届的同学们，你们正在进入一个我们像叠叠乐塔一样被推倒的世界，我们依靠你们来重建它。

sentences.en: But how can you do that with the knowledge that things are so unstable out there?
sentences.zh: 但既然知道外面的事情如此不稳定，你怎么能做到这一点呢？

sentences.en: I'll tell you my secret, the one thing that has kept me going through the years, my super power.
sentences.zh: 我会告诉你我的秘密，多年来让我坚持下去的一件事，我的超能力。

sentences.en: Delusion. (audience laughs) This is something I may share with our president, a fact that is both horrifying and interesting.
sentences.zh: 错觉。 （观众笑）这是我可以与我们的总统分享的事情，一个既可怕又有趣的事实。

sentences.en: (audience laughs) Two years in, I think we can pretty safely say that he's not getting carved onto Mount Rushmore but damn if that is not a testament to how far you can get by just by believing that you are the smartest, most successful person
sentences.zh: （观众笑）两年后，我想我们可以相当有把握地说他不会被刻在拉什莫尔山上，但如果这不能证明你可以通过相信自己是最聪明、最成功的人来走多远，那该死的

sentences.en: in the world. My point is, you have to have insane confidence in yourself, even if it's not real.
sentences.zh: 在世界上。我的观点是，你必须对自己有疯狂的信心，即使这不是真的。

sentences.en: You need to be your own cheerleader now because there isn't a room full of people waiting with pom poms to tell you "You did it!
sentences.zh: 你现在需要成为你自己的啦啦队长，因为没有一屋子的人拿着绒球等着告诉你“你做到了！

sentences.en: "We've been waiting all this time for you to succeed!"
sentences.zh: “我们一直在等你成功！”

sentences.en: So I'm giving you permission to root for yourself.
sentences.zh: 所以我允许你为自己加油。

sentences.en: And while you're at it, root for those around you too.
sentences.zh: 当你这样做的时候，也要为你周围的人加油。

sentences.en: It took me a long time to realize that success isn't a zero sum game, which leads me to the next part of my remarks.
sentences.zh: 我花了很长时间才意识到成功并不是一场零和游戏，这让我开始了我的演讲的下一部分。

sentences.en: I thought I might take a second to speak to the ladies in the audience.
sentences.zh: 我想我可以花点时间和观众席上的女士们谈谈。

sentences.en: Guys, take a break. You don't have to pay attention during this part.
sentences.zh: 伙计们，休息一下吧。这部分你不需要注意。

sentences.en: Maybe spend the next 30 seconds thinking about all the extra money you'll make in your life for doing the same job as a woman.
sentences.zh: 也许在接下来的 30 秒里想一想，作为女性做同样的工作，你一生中会赚到多少额外的钱。

sentences.en: Pretty sweet. (audience laughs) Hey, girls.
sentences.zh: 相当甜蜜。 （观众笑）嘿，女孩们。

sentences.en: We need to do a better job of supporting each other.
sentences.zh: 我们需要更好地相互支持。

sentences.en: (audience applauds) I know that I am guilty of it too.
sentences.zh: （众鼓掌）我知道我也有罪。

sentences.en: We live in a world where it seems like there's only room for one of us at the table.
sentences.zh: 我们生活在一个似乎餐桌上只有我们一个人的世界。

sentences.en: So when another woman shows up, we think "Oh my god, she's gonna take the one woman spot.
sentences.zh: 因此，当另一个女人出现时，我们会想“天哪，她会取代那个女人的位置。

sentences.en: "That was supposed to be mine." But that's just what certain people want us to do.
sentences.zh: “那本来应该是我的。”但这正是某些人希望我们做的。

sentences.en: Wouldn't it be better if we worked together to dismantle a system that makes us feel like there's limited room for us?
sentences.zh: 如果我们共同努力拆除一个让我们感觉空间有限的系统，不是更好吗？

sentences.en: Because when women work together, we can accomplish anything, even stealing the world's most expensive diamond necklace from the Met Gala, like in Ocean's Eight, a movie starring me which opens in theaters June 8th.
sentences.zh: 因为当女性共同努力时，我们可以完成任何事情，甚至可以从 Met Gala 上偷走世界上最昂贵的钻石项链，就像我主演的电影《八罗汉》，将于 6 月 8 日在影院上映。

sentences.en: (audience laughs) And to that end, women, don't be ashamed to toot your own horn like I just did.
sentences.zh: （观众笑）为此，女士们，不要羞于像我刚才那样自吹自擂。

sentences.en: Okay, guys, you can listen again. You didn't miss much.
sentences.zh: 好吧，伙计们，你们可以再听一遍。你并没有错过太多。

sentences.en: Just remember to see Ocean's Eight, now playing in theaters nationwide.
sentences.zh: 请记住观看《八罗汉》，该剧目前正在全国影院上映。

sentences.en: Ocean's Eight, every con has its pros. (audience laughs) Now I wanted to share a little bit about me, Mindy Kaling, the Dartmouth student.
sentences.zh: 八罗汉，每一个缺点都有它的优点。 （观众笑）现在我想分享一些关于我的事，Mindy Kaling，达特茅斯学院的学生。

sentences.en: When I came to Hanover in the fall of 1997, I was as many of you were.
sentences.zh: 1997 年秋天，当我来到汉诺威时，我和你们一样。

sentences.en: Driven, bright, ambitious, and really, really into the Black Eyed Peas.
sentences.zh: 干劲十足、聪明、雄心勃勃，而且非常非常喜欢黑眼豆豆。

sentences.en: (audience laughs) I arrived here as a 17 year old, took the lay of the land, and immediately began making a checklist of everything I wanted to accomplish.
sentences.zh: （观众笑）我17岁时来到这里，了解了情况，并立即开始列出我想要完成的所有事情的清单。

sentences.en: I told myself that by the time I graduated in 2001, I would have checked them all off.
sentences.zh: 我告诉自己，当我 2001 年毕业时，我会把它们全部划掉。

sentences.en: And here is my freshman fall checklist. Be on Hanover Crew, be on Launch Crew.
sentences.zh: 这是我的新生秋季清单。成为汉诺威船员，成为发射船员。

sentences.en: - [Man] Yeah! - Be in an acapella group, be in an improv troupe, write a play that's performed at the Bentley, and do a cartoon for the D.
sentences.zh: - [男人] 是啊！ - 加入无伴奏合唱团，加入即兴剧团，写一部在宾利剧院演出的戏剧，并为 D 剧院制作一部动画片。

sentences.en: And try to be in a cool senior society. Guess what?
sentences.zh: 并尝试进入一个很酷的老年人社会。你猜怎么着？

sentences.en: I completed that checklist. But before you think, "Wait, why is this woman just bragging "about her accomplishments from 17 years ago?"
sentences.zh: 我完成了该清单。但在你思考之前，“等等，为什么这个女人只是吹嘘“她 17 年前的成就？”

sentences.en: Keep listening. Then I graduated and I made a new checklist for my 20s.
sentences.zh: 继续听。然后我毕业了，我为我的 20 多岁制定了一份新的清单。

sentences.en: Get married by 27, have kids at 30, win an Oscar, be the star of my own TV show, host the MTV Music Awards.
sentences.zh: 27 岁结婚，30 岁生孩子，赢得奥斯卡奖，成为自己电视节目的明星，主持 MTV 音乐奖。

sentences.en: This was 2001, guys, it made more sense then.
sentences.zh: 那是 2001 年，伙计们，那时更有意义。

sentences.en: (audience laughs) And do it all while being a size two.
sentences.zh: （观众笑）并且在身为二号的时候完成这一切。

sentences.en: Well, spoiler alert, I've only done one of those things and I'm not sure I will ever do the others.
sentences.zh: 好吧，剧透警告，我只做了其中一件事情，我不确定我是否会做其他事情。

sentences.en: And that is a really scary feeling, knowing how far that I've strayed from the person that I was hoping to be when I was 21.
sentences.zh: 那种感觉真的很可怕，因为我知道我已经偏离了 21 岁时我希望成为的人有多远。

sentences.en: I will tell you a personal story. After my daughter was born in December, I remember bringing her home and being in my house with her for the first time, thinking "Huh, according to movies and TV, "this is traditionally the time when my mother
sentences.zh: 我会告诉你一个个人故事。 12月我女儿出生后，我记得第一次带她回家，第一次和她一起呆在我家里，心想“呃，根据电影和电视，”这是传统上我妈妈的时间

sentences.en: "and spouse are supposed to be here, "sharing this experience with me."
sentences.zh: “而配偶应该在这里，”与我分享这段经历。

sentences.en: And I looked around and I had neither. And for a moment, it was kind of scary, like can I do this by myself?
sentences.zh: 我环顾四周，却什么也没有。有那么一刻，我有点害怕，我自己能做到吗？

sentences.en: But then that feeling went away because the reality is I'm not doing it by myself.
sentences.zh: 但后来这种感觉消失了，因为现实是我不是自己做的。

sentences.en: I'm surrounded by family and friends who love and support me.
sentences.zh: 我周围都是爱我、支持我的家人和朋友。

sentences.en: And the joy I feel from being with my daughter Katherine eclipses anything from any crazy checklist.
sentences.zh: 我和女儿凯瑟琳在一起所感受到的快乐超越了任何疯狂清单上的任何东西。

sentences.en: So I just want to tell you guys, don't be scared if you don't do things in the right order or if you don't do some things at all.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是想告诉大家，如果你没有按照正确的顺序做事或者根本不做某些事情，不要害怕。

sentences.en: I didn't think I'd have a child before I got married but hey, it turned out that way and I wouldn't change a thing.
sentences.zh: 我没想到在结婚前我会生孩子，但是结果就是这样，我不会改变任何事情。

sentences.en: I didn't think I'd have dessert before breakfast today but hey, it turned out that way and I wouldn't change a thing.
sentences.zh: 我没想到今天早餐前我会吃甜点，但是嘿，结果就是这样，我不会改变任何事情。

sentences.en: (audience laughs) So if I could impart any advice, it's this.
sentences.zh: （观众笑）所以如果我能提供任何建议，那就是这个。

sentences.en: If you have a checklist, good for you. Structured ambition can sometimes be motivating.
sentences.zh: 如果您有一份清单，对您有好处。有组织的野心有时可以起到激励作用。

sentences.en: But also, feel free to let it go. Yes, my culminating advice from my speech is a song from the Disney animated movie Frozen.
sentences.zh: 但同时，请随意放手。是的，我演讲中的最终建议是迪士尼动画电影《冰雪奇缘》中的一首歌曲。

sentences.en: (audience laughs) I've covered a lot of ground today, not all of it was serious, but I wanted to leave you with this.
sentences.zh: （观众笑）我今天讲了很多内容，并不是所有内容都很严肃，但我想把这个留给你们。

sentences.en: I was not someone who should have the life I have now and yet I do.
sentences.zh: 我本来不应该拥有现在的生活，但我却做到了。

sentences.en: I was sitting in the chair you are literally sitting in right now and I just whispered "Why not me?"
sentences.zh: 我坐在你现在坐的椅子上，我只是低声说：“为什么不是我呢？”

sentences.en: And I kept whispering it for 17 years and here I am, someone that this school deemed worthy enough to speak to you at your commencement.
sentences.zh: 十七年来我一直在低声诉说这句话，而我就在这里，学校认为我有足够的资格在你们的毕业典礼上对你们讲话。

sentences.en: Don't let anyone tell you that you can't do something, but especially not yourself.
sentences.zh: 不要让任何人告诉你你不能做某事，尤其是你自己。

sentences.en: Go conquer the world. Just remember this.
sentences.zh: 去征服世界吧。只要记住这一点。

sentences.en: Why not you? You made it this far. Thank you very much and congratulations to the class of 2018.
sentences.zh: 为什么不是你呢？你已经做到了这一步。非常感谢并祝贺 2018 届毕业生。

sentences.en: (audience applauds)
sentences.zh: （观众鼓掌）
